author: goblirsc
body:
#### PR description:

This PR implements the solution proposed in #52257 for enabling ALCACRECO workflows in Phase-2 cosmic muon setups.
To achieve this, the ALCARECO collections 
```
ALCARECOTkAlCosmicsRegional
ALCARECOTkAlCosmicsRegional0T
ALCARECOTkAlCosmicsDuringCollisions0T
```
are patched to load an existing Phase-2 cosmic track collection, until they are either removed or their source track producers updated to Phase-2 in the future.

The WF 7.5 test is extended to run the ALCARECO step. 

In addition, an experimental change is added that allows the harvesting step to run.
This required adding an import to `HarvestingCosmics_cff` to expose the needed producers - it should be double-checked whether this is desired. 

The changes were discussed in the [21.10.](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1724610/#44-discussion-input-cosmics-in) and  [28.10.](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1724617/#20-cosmic-track-finder-results) Tracker DPG/POG meetings. 

#### PR validation:

- WF 7.5 now runs including steps 4 and 5, ALCARECO and HARVESTCOS. 


#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:
 
No backport intended. Only target Phase-2.
title: patch ALCARECO for Phase-2 cosmic processing
